```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"rust\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {\n    a + b\n}\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language)
debugPrint(result.structure)
debugPrint(result.structure[0].kind)
debugPrint(result.metrics.totalLines)
```
